name: INDONESIAN BACCARAT
description: Indonesian Baccarat (locally known as Bakarat) refers to the standard European Baccarat game as played and adapted in Indonesian card rooms and social gambling circles. It is a game of pure chance where players bet on the 'Player' or 'Banker' hands to reach a total closest to nine.

content.text: Indonesian Baccarat (locally known as Bakarat) refers to the standard European Baccarat game as played and adapted in Indonesian card rooms and social gambling circles. It is a game of pure chance where players bet on the 'Player' or 'Banker' hands to reach a total closest to nine.
Baccarat was introduced to Indonesia via international trade and colonial influence. It became a staple in private clubs and regulated casinos (when they were operational).
Typically 8 standard decks (~416 cards) shuffled together.

items.text: Punto Banco: Standard house-banked form; fixed tableau; no player choices. Indonesian play often follows this.
Mini-baccarat: Smaller table, lower minimums; same rules; popular with casual and Asian-market players.
Tie and side bets: Local tie-payout and Southeast Asian side bets (e.g. Dragon, pairs) vary by venue.
